title: Ubi Ọganihu Na-apụ Apụ
intro: N'ala jupụtara n'ihe bara ụba, obodo ahụ toro nke ọma, bi n'etiti ihe ịrịba ama nke amara Chineke. Ọganihu ha bụ ihe akaebe nke amara Onyenwe ha, onyinye e zubere iji kpalie ekele na nrubeisi. Ma, n'agbanyeghị ihe ngosi doro anya nke ngọzi ha, oge mgbanwe bịara, na-ama aka n'ekele ha maka isi iyi nke akụnụba na nkasi obi ha dị ukwuu.
clues: Anyị nwetara ubi abụọ, otu n'aka nri na otu n'aka ekpe, jupụtara na ihe ubi.
E nyere anyị iwu ka anyị rie ihe sitere n'ihe Onyenwe anyị nyere anyị ma kelee Ya maka ala dị mma na Onyenwe anyị na-agbaghara mmehie.
Anyị dị mpako ma si n'ụzọ ekele pụọ, na-anya isi n'akụnụba na ike anyị.
Anyị rịọrọ ka Onyenwe anyị mee ka anya dị n'etiti njem anyị dịkwuo elu, na-egosi ịkpọasị maka mfe O nyere anyị.
Onye ozi dọrọ anyị aka ná ntị, mana anyị jụrụ ozi ahụ wee nọgide na-eleghara ya anya.
E mebiri nnukwu ọdọ mmiri anyị, nke mere ka anyị nwee ọganihu, nke mere ka idei mmiri jupụta ebe niile.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Mwakpo nke ndị agha dị ike
Ala ọma jijiji nke mebiri emebi
Idei mmiri mebiri emebi sitere na ihe mgbochi mmiri gbawara agbawa
Mmegbu sitere n'aka onye ọchịchị aka ike
trial.answer: Idei mmiri mebiri emebi sitere na ihe mgbochi mmiri gbawara agbawa

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A gbanwere anyị ka anyị ghọọ enwe na ezi
A zọpụtara anyị ma kwaga anyị n'ala ọhụrụ
Anyị gbasasịrị, ala anyị wee ghọọ ihe efu
Anyị wuru alaeze ọhụrụ, nke bara ọgaranya karịa
outcome.answer: Anyị gbasasịrị, ala anyị wee ghọọ ihe efu

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
